steps.title: Gather the claim packet
steps.what: Collected 8 synthetic FNOL packets: police report (PNG + PDF), damage photo, phone note.
steps.code:
for p in packets:
    files = [p / 'police_report.pdf', p / 'damage_photo.png',
             p / 'phone_note.txt']
    content = packet_content(files, instructions)  # document + image blocks
steps.output:
Packet CLM-5001:
  police_report.png  (40 KB)
  police_report.pdf  (62 KB)
  police_report.txt  (1 KB)
  damage_photo.png  (3 KB)
  phone_note.txt  (1 KB)

phone_note.txt:
FNOL call 11/17 9:57am. Caller Jordan Reyes, policy PA-349573. Says it happened 11/16 at Elm St & 4th Ave. Vehicle 1 was struck while stopped at a red light. Driver cooperative. Body shop guessed about $2,400. Nobody hurt. Callback 555-0124. Police report RPD-26-27357 filed.

steps.title: Extract fields into the claims schema, with a confidence per field
steps.what: One vision call per packet reads the report and photo together; offline, the stand-in parses the OCR text, the phone note, and measures the red damage area in the photo.
steps.code:
ex = ask_structured(system=SYSTEM, content=content,
                    schema=ClaimExtraction)
# offline: regex on report + note; severity from red pixels
share = red_pixels / vehicle_pixels  # <4.5% minor, <14% moderate

steps.title: Route by severity: fast-track, adjuster or special unit
steps.what: Fraud flags go to the special investigations unit; coverage questions, injuries or moderate-plus damage go to an adjuster; the rest fast-track.
steps.code:
route = ('special_unit' if flags else
         'adjuster' if coverage or severity != 'minor'
                    or injuries or amount >= 5000 else
         'fast_track')

steps.title: Low-confidence fields go to a person before anything is saved
steps.what: 3 fields on 3 claims fell under the 80% bar and were checked against the originals; the rest saved straight through.
steps.code:
low = [f for f in ex.fields if f.confidence < 0.80]
if low: review_queue.post(claim_id, low)   # n8n IF node, false branch
else:   claims_api.post(record)            # true branch
route = check_and_route(record_after_review)

CLM-5008  estimated_amount_usd  extracted=None                 conf=0.00  reviewer=3100

story.situation: A regional auto insurer takes about 300 first notices of loss a week. Each arrives as photos, a police report and a phone note, and an adjuster retypes it all into the claims system before anyone triages it.
story.constraints: Nothing reaches the claims system unless every field is confident or a person has checked it. Fraud and coverage rules stay in plain code so auditors can read them. Claimant data stays inside the insurer's tenant.
story.replay: Reuse: 'extract with a confidence per field, check with plain rules, send only the doubtful fields to a person' fits any document intake (loan files, invoices, onboarding). Next time: measure reviewer edits per field and tune the confidence bar per field rather than one bar for all.
